description: List the photos in a Pedra property as img.pedra.ai URLs, ready to pass straight to pedra_create_video or the image-editing tools. Get the propertyId from pedra_list_properties. Pass type "360" to list its 360° photos instead (their imageIds are the scenes of a virtual tour).

type.description: Which images to list: regular photos ("photo", the default) or 360° photos ("360").

name: pedra_list_property_images
title: List property photos
